blocks.text: CEBU CITY — With roughly three months left, preparations for the Sinulog Festival 2027 are officially underway. For next year’s festivities, however, contingents and other participants should expect austerity measures as organizers adapt to economic challenges. Registration for major competitions such as the Ritual Showdown, Grand Parade, and Puppeteers is now open, Elmer “Jojo” Labella, executive director of the Sinulog Foundation Inc. (SFI), announced. READ: Sinulog 2027 float sponsorship rises to P800K amid cost pressures Registrations are expected to close Nov. 30 or Dec. 1 this year.
